contexts.text: Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter () = conjunction not lawful... The defilement of marriages = conjunction not lawful.
Because he defiled Dinah their sister = initiation to conjunction.
To defile the houses, and fill the courts with the slain () = to profane goods and truths.
Because they had defiled their sister = because they had defiled the truth of faith.
Defiled garments () = truths defiled by the falsities which are from evil. AE 740:16.
Thus are Knowledges from the Word polluted and defiled by the loves of self and of the world...
To defile the temple of holiness () = to profane worship.
